text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Quantile score of the physics core minus XGBoost fitted on the inputs shown (each row adds to the row above), ERA5 as the weather, rows kept by the mask. Positive: XGBoost better. Grey line: same as the core. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months and seeds. 3 wind farms, 53 Tuesday runs, 3 seeds, July 2025 to June 2026.'
